meta.title: Apprenticeships: starts, achievements and participation by learner home location, age, level and sector subject area
meta.geography: LA, PCON (2024 constituencies whose name contains Bedford/Luton: Bedford, Mid Bedfordshire, North Bedfordshire, Luton North, Luton South and South Bedfordshire - Hitchin, which takes part of Central Bedfordshire, is not included), region, England; Bedfordshire 3-UA total
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics from the Individualised Learner Record (ILR); a census of funded apprenticeship learners. In-year figures (latest year, Aug-Apr) are provisional and will rise when the full year is reported; earlier years are final full-year counts.
meta.limitations: Geography is the LEARNER'S HOME postcode (not provider or employer location). Volumes rounded to the nearest 10 by DfE and cells below 5 shown as 'low' (null, suppressed=true), so Bedfordshire sums and small SSA x level cells carry rounding error. Sector subject area (SSA tier 1) x LA detail is published one year per release, so SSA rows cover 2023/24 and 2024/25 (full year, from the two previous releases) plus 2025/26 in-year only; hospitality sits within 'Retail and Commercial Enterprise' and 'Leisure, Travel and Tourism'. Starts counted per programme (one learner may start more than one). Methodology breaks: 2017 apprenticeship levy/funding reform (starts fell sharply in 2017/18); transition from frameworks to standards (all standards since 2020/21); COVID-19 depressed 2019/20-2020/21. Starts rates per 100,000 use ONS mid-year population for the age band. Age = age at start.
